description: Check for the SMS / OTP code on an order. Returns the code once it has arrived, otherwise an empty result: poll again after a few seconds. If nothing lands after a minute or two, the fastest path is to order a fresh number with create_otp_order (prefer the "us1" Non-VoIP pool) and leave the original: it auto-refunds within 10 minutes. Never cancel just to retry, and there is no charge for ordering again, you only pay for codes that arrive.
name: poll_sms
title: Check for the verification code
